title: Linked Boulders
texts:
The goal of this workout is to increase short power endurance for short routes, crux sequences or longer boulder problems.

Find 1-3 boulder problems that are 12 moves long and is around your flash grade. If you have a particular problem that you enjoy or wish to work extensively then you can complete the entire session on a single problem or for variety use up to 3 different problems. Try to choose problem(s) that are sustained in difficulty throughout the climb. In many gyms you may struggle to find 12 move boulder problems, in this instance add 2-4 hard traverse moves into the start of the problem. 

Climb your chosen problem 4 times resting for 2 minutes before each rep. This is one set.  Complete 3 sets in total with 5 minutes rest between sets.

It is okay to fail on the last few moves at the end of each set but if you consistently fall off before getting half way through the problem you should look to drop the difficulty of climbing.  If you complete 100% of this session with no falls, increase the difficulty in the next session.  Change the boulder problems used every few sessions.
